title: Re: MayaValley – Positron AI: Quick Follow‑Up, Commitments by Monday 10am
description:
Hi all,

Following up on the Positron AI opportunity - thanks to those who have
already committed. A few investors have asked for additional time; we’ve
been able to secure an allocation at the oversubscribed lower $3.5B
valuation and now need to lock in our final size. *Please let us know your
commitment by Monday 10am PT.*

A few additional data points that may help as you evaluate:

   - *Market size*

*Total inference hardware compute market is projected at roughly $80B to
$755B* by 2030, with Positron positioned to capture a meaningful share of
that growth given its focus on energy‑efficient AI inference silicon.


   - *Execution and traction*

Positron’s 2026 expected revenue is ~$100M (per management), with a
qualified pipeline of ~$350M across hyperscaler, trading/energy, and
AI‑native customers; management expects revenue to grow to ~$2.5B over the
next three years. They describe the business as “shipping at scale” with
fewer people and less capital than any other AI semiconductor startup, with
roughly 80% of headcount in engineering, and project being cash‑positive by
mid‑next year.


   - *Modeled upside*

*The company’s modeling suggests a potential 3x–13x return on our entry
price based on a valuation range of roughly $11B to $46B, comparable to
other recent AI infrastructure and semiconductor companies.*

Caption: One of the October’s two USWNT games will be played in Washington, DC. (Erin Chang/ISI Photos/Getty Images)

* The US first faces the European titan at Washington, DC’s Audi Field on October 10th, before capping the series at Pennsylvania’s Subaru Park on October 13th.
